messages.subject: Distance fo WIndows: no analysis results being displayed
parts:
Hey, all,
sorry if that has been asked before:
I am still using DIstance for Windows.
On my current laptop (Dell Latitude 5500 64bit, with WIndows version Windows 10Pro 22H2), in DISTANCE version 7.5 and also older ones (e.g. 6.9), I do not see the analysis results being displayed after they ran. I can see the results in the summary table, though.
Any ideas?
Matthias

Matthias

Other users have encountered this problem previously.  The remedy can be found in this thread from the list back in 2021

https://groups.google.com/g/distance-sampling/c/DO5Uz6prTKg/m/J3bxW4s9AwAJ

Check the language setting of your Windows operating system (as shown in the thread). Alternatively, ask Distance for Windows not to compress the results.

If you have other questions, please ask.

thank you for the swift reply! Just ticking the box to not compress the results (under 'Distance Preferences'/'General') worked for me!
Thanks again!
Matthias
